threads.subject: St. Louis Cardinals staff and front office

reports.text: As we wait for the Cardinals to officially announce their 2027 coaching staff, a look at what it means to be a hitting coach in a modern context, and the task awaiting Joel McKeithan: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/the-cardin...

Analysis of Randy Flores' Friday departure to Houston, including an explanation of the structure of the Cardinals front office, some staff who could depart with him, and what it has to do with the coaching staff not yet being announced. All here: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/randy-flor...
The Cardinals hired Randy Flores in 2015 to replace Chris Correa, who received a 46-month prison sentence after hacking into an Astros personnel and scouting database in 2013 and 2014.

With Matt Kleine in limbo, St. Louis Cardinals AGM Randy Flores has emerged as a serious candidate for the Astros' GM opening, according to multiple sources. With @katiejwoo.bsky.social and @ken-rosenthal.bsky.social - www.nytimes.com/athletic/774...
Cardinals say they officially declined Ryne Stanek’s option and reinstated Max Rajcic. Chase Hampton, who they claimed on waivers a month ago, was claimed by Baltimore. 40-man is at 38.
None of the three Cardinals finalists for Gold Gloves won their awards. JJ Wetherholt, Masyn Winn and Michael McGreevy were beaten out by Brice Turang, Geraldo Perdomo and Nolan McLean.

As soon as the parade is over in Wisconsin (grab your spots on the route now), the offseason is ready to kick into high gear just in time to shut back down in a month. This is how that lays out for the Cardinals, who have new opportunities to seize: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/with-the-b...
Cardinals say they officially declined Ryne Stanek’s option and reinstated Max Rajcic. Chase Hampton, who they claimed on waivers a month ago, was claimed by Baltimore. 40-man is at 38.

Today is the 40-man compliance deadline and the official opening of free agency. The Cardinals will have to finalize their decline of Ryne Stanek’s option, as @dgoold.bsky.social reported last night. They also haven’t yet formally activated Max Rajcic from the 60-day IL.
